findings: Affine attributes share one interpolation request per tile; perspective attributes share another. Flat attributes retain their original values. Arithmetic remains on the selected provider.

Independent mixed-interpolation tests cover two affine, two perspective and one flat varying, nonuniform homogeneous W, both 256- and 4096-pixel batches, and the existing edge, odd-size, derivative and sparse-tile cases.
Both original full desktop draw captures pass their scalar oracle and CPU/NPU comparison. All seventeen prewarm images remain byte-exact against the qualified baseline.

Both runtimes pass their clean CPU suites. Native NPU qualification covers triangle rendering, derivatives, compositor shaders, typed loads, loops, masks, mirror sampling, driver draws/clears and legacy compatibility.
This qualifies a candidate for an installed desktop trial. Full desktop offload and Tahoma performance remain unverified. No compiled-model sharing is included.
